title: Video Palace
subtitle: Found-audio horror about cursed media and the kind of mystery that keeps getting worse.
description: A compact horror serial about a cursed VHS tape, a missing-store legend, and the way media obsession becomes the path into something older and meaner.

length.label: 14 current feed episodes including bonus material.

similarReasons.archive-81: Another media-shaped horror route where the format itself becomes part of the trap.
similarReasons.malevolent: A more overt occult branch if you want the threat to stay intimate and personal.
similarReasons.the-white-vault: Keeps the atmosphere oppressive while shifting from expedition horror to cursed-media investigation.
similarReasons.mirrors: A cleaner supernatural-technology branch once you want another completed eerie route.

archiveTake: A strong short-run recommendation for listeners who want creepy recorded-media horror without committing to a huge catalog.
